title: Diagram source
description: The authoritative source of a generated slide diagram. Every element is explicitly positioned in its parent group's coordinates; the CLI renders it deterministically to the slide's SVG, emitting each element as an element id Items can select. Element order is reading order and breaks ties between equal z values.

reveal.description: Opt-in staggered entrance: the reviewer fades the drawing in step by step each time its slide is shown. Thumbnails, exports, landmark links, and readers who prefer reduced motion see the finished drawing.

styles.description: Named styles; a name matching a default (normal, primary, emphasis, secondary, warning, boundary, title, caption, code) replaces it completely.

terminator.description: An edge end: arrow, open, triangle (UML generalization), diamond and filled-diamond (aggregation, composition), circle, dot, bar, or an ERD crow's-foot cardinality.

color.description: #rrggbb and none stay as authored; @name references a colour token of the theme contract (change-saga spec, theme), such as @diagram-primary-fill or @accent, and follows light and dark mode.

kind.description: A sticky is a palette-coloured square of wrapped label text; an annotation is a bubble, pin, highlight, or bracket. Describe lists both as notes about their about element.

shape.description: Node shape; a group with rect or boundary draws a frame around its children, and with section a tinted frame whose label sits in a title tab. The node shapes after boundary center their icon, label, and detail in a text area inside the outline and default to align middle; a circle needs equal width and height, and an entity draws an ERD table of its fields. An annotation is a bubble, pin, highlight, or bracket.

description.description: Semantic explanation read by describe and assistive technology; not drawn.

note.description: Optional depth on demand, not drawn: Markdown limited to bold, italics, inline code, lists, and http, https, or mailto links (no raw HTML, headings, images, tables, or code blocks). The reviewer shows it rendered when a reader hovers, focuses, or taps the element; describe prints it; the SVG carries it as plain text in the element's desc. Not allowed on decorative elements.

icon.description: A bundled icon; list them with change-saga diagram icons.

label_box.description: Element-local box for an edge label or a node label placed outside its shape.

fragment.description: Allowlisted SVG drawing markup for a graphic; currentColor follows its style's stroke.

decorative.description: Hidden from describe and assistive technology; may not contain semantic children.

tail_label.description: Text at the edge's start, such as an ERD cardinality; needs tail_label_box.

head_label.description: Text at the edge's end, such as an ERD cardinality; needs head_label_box.

curve.description: smooth draws the edge's points as a curve through every point.

line.description: Overrides the style's dash for this edge.

fields.description: An entity node's rows, in order: each field's key marker, name, and type. Row i spans y = header + 28i inside the node, where header = the style's font_size * 1.25 + 16.

from_field.description: The field of the from entity this edge ends on; drawing still follows the edge's explicit points or path.

to_field.description: The field of the to entity this edge ends on.

color.description: Renderer-owned palette colour of a sticky, section, or annotation; stickies and highlights default to yellow, the rest to gray.

about.description: The semantic element a sticky or annotation is about; describe prints it, and a bubble without a target points at its box.

target.description: Element-local point a bubble's pointer reaches; it must lie outside the bubble.

side.description: The side of its box a bracket's point faces.

code.description: Literal multiline source for a code element. Never executed; indentation and blank lines are preserved.

language.description: Optional display label, such as go, Python, TypeScript, or HTTP.

step.description: When the element appears in the document's reveal; requires reveal. Defaults to its reading order among semantic elements; a decorative element without a step appears with its group, or from the start. Equal steps appear together, gaps cost no time, and no element appears before its group.
